nodes.name: camera.cpp
nodes.summary: Defines the global Camera singleton and LookAt/perspective matrix helpers used by rendering and every camera controller.
nodes.languageNotes: Stores one process-wide Camera in a translation-unit static and exposes it through GetCamera/SetCamera.

nodes.name: camera.h
nodes.summary: Look-at camera value type with position, target, up, FOV, and clip planes plus accessors for the process-wide Camera instance.

nodes.name: camera_director.cpp
nodes.summary: Sole writer of the global Camera: samples Follow, first-person, scene-node, or intro poses and eases between them unless the debug camera is enabled.

nodes.name: camera_director.h
nodes.summary: Declares CameraDirectorSource and the director API that blends Follow, SceneNode, Intro, and FirstPerson producers into the global Camera.

nodes.name: camera_pose.cpp
nodes.summary: Converts between global Camera, CameraComponent/Transform nodes, and CameraPose, including spherical look-direction blends.
nodes.languageNotes: Slerps look direction via an orthonormal axis when vectors are nearly opposite, then rebuilds a local basis for Transform write-back.

nodes.name: camera_pose.h
nodes.summary: Shared CameraPose struct (eye, lookAt, up, FOV, clip) and conversion helpers used by the director and gameplay cameras.

nodes.name: debug_camera.cpp
nodes.summary: Editor debug camera with Maya-style Alt+mouse orbit/pan/dolly and Unity-style RMB+WASD fly, toggled with F1.

nodes.name: Camera
nodes.summary: Look-at camera holding position, target, up, FOV, and clip distances, and producing view/projection matrices.

nodes.name: GetCamera
nodes.summary: Returns the process-wide Camera singleton used by rendering and all camera controllers.

nodes.name: SetCamera
nodes.summary: Replaces the process-wide Camera singleton with a copied Camera value.

nodes.name: Camera
nodes.summary: Default constructor placing the camera at the origin looking down +Z with 45-degree FOV.

nodes.name: SetPosition
nodes.summary: Sets the camera eye position.

nodes.name: SetTarget
nodes.summary: Sets the look-at target point.

nodes.name: SetUp
nodes.summary: Sets the camera up vector.

nodes.name: SetFov
nodes.summary: Sets vertical field of view in degrees.

nodes.name: SetClip
nodes.summary: Sets near and far clip distances.

nodes.name: GetViewMatrix
nodes.summary: Builds a left-handed look-at view matrix from position, target, and up.

nodes.name: GetProjMatrix
nodes.summary: Builds a left-handed perspective projection from FOV, aspect, and clip planes.

nodes.name: GetForward
nodes.summary: Returns the normalized vector from camera position toward the look-at target.

nodes.name: TrySampleSceneNode
nodes.summary: Reads CameraPose from the editor-named active CameraComponent node if it is enabled.

nodes.name: TrySampleActiveSource
nodes.summary: Samples Follow, first-person, or scene-node pose depending on the current director source.

nodes.name: CameraDirector_Initialize
nodes.summary: Seeds director state from the current global Camera and default blend duration.

nodes.name: CameraDirector_SetSource
nodes.summary: Switches the active producer and starts a blend from the current global pose.

nodes.name: CameraDirector_GetSource
nodes.summary: Returns the current CameraDirectorSource (Follow, SceneNode, Intro, or FirstPerson).

nodes.name: CameraDirector_SetIntroPosition
nodes.summary: Writes the intro producer eye position (used by intro camera scripts).

nodes.name: CameraDirector_SetIntroTarget
nodes.summary: Writes the intro producer look-at target.

nodes.name: CameraDirector_SetIntroUp
nodes.summary: Writes the intro producer up vector.

nodes.name: CameraDirector_GetIntroPose
nodes.summary: Returns the current intro CameraPose written by script camera setters.

nodes.name: CameraDirector_SetBlendDuration
nodes.summary: Sets the ease duration used when switching director sources.

nodes.name: CameraDirector_Update
nodes.summary: Each frame samples the active source, eases toward it, and writes the result to the global Camera unless debug camera owns the view.

nodes.name: SlerpDir
nodes.summary: Spherically interpolates unit directions, falling back to lerp or an orthonormal axis when inputs are parallel.

nodes.name: ExtractLook
nodes.summary: Splits a CameraPose into a look distance and normalized forward for blend math.

nodes.name: CameraPose_FromGlobal
nodes.summary: Snapshots the process-wide Camera into a CameraPose.

nodes.name: CameraPose_ApplyToGlobal
nodes.summary: Writes a CameraPose onto the process-wide Camera (position, target, up, FOV, clip).

nodes.name: CameraPose_Lerp
nodes.summary: Blends two poses by lerping eye along look distance and slerping view direction.

nodes.name: CameraPose_FromComponent
nodes.summary: Builds a CameraPose from a CameraComponent and Transform using world-space eye/forward/up.

nodes.name: CameraPose_WriteToNode
nodes.summary: Writes a CameraPose back onto a Transform as an orthonormal local basis plus CameraComponent FOV/clip.

nodes.name: InitFromCameraOnce
nodes.summary: Seeds orbit yaw, pitch, distance, and focal point from the current global Camera the first time orbit starts.

nodes.name: UpdateCameraFromOrbit
nodes.summary: Recomputes Camera position/target/up from orbit yaw, pitch, distance, and focal point.

nodes.name: ApplyFlyViewToCamera
nodes.summary: Applies fly-mode position plus yaw/pitch forward onto the global Camera.

nodes.name: UpdateFlyMode
nodes.summary: RMB look plus WASD/Space/Ctrl fly movement with Shift boost, writing the result to the global Camera.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_IsEnabled
nodes.summary: Returns whether the debug camera currently owns the global Camera.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetControlMode
nodes.summary: Switches between Orbit (Maya Alt+mouse) and Fly (RMB+WASD) control.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_GetControlMode
nodes.summary: Returns the active DebugCameraControlMode.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetFlyView
nodes.summary: Seeds fly-mode world position and yaw/pitch in degrees, then applies it immediately.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetEnabled
nodes.summary: Enables or disables debug camera, initializing orbit or fly state from the current view.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetMoveSpeed
nodes.summary: Sets base fly move speed in units per second.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetBoostMultiplier
nodes.summary: Sets the Shift fly-speed multiplier.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetMouseSensitivity
nodes.summary: Sets fly look sensitivity in degrees per pixel.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetOrbitSensitivity
nodes.summary: Sets orbit tumble sensitivity.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetPanSensitivity
nodes.summary: Sets orbit pan sensitivity.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetDollySensitivity
nodes.summary: Sets orbit dolly/zoom sensitivity.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SetFocalPoint
nodes.summary: Sets the orbit focal point the camera tumbles around.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_SyncOrbitFromCurrentView
nodes.summary: Rebuilds orbit yaw/pitch/distance from the current Camera position and target.

nodes.name: DebugCamera_Update
nodes.summary: Per-frame debug camera: F1 toggle, ImGui capture guards, Maya Alt orbit/pan/dolly, wheel dolly, and RMB fly.
